policy_metadata.title: Gate G12 Field Commissioning Fail-Closed Lockout Policy

overview.description: Formal Gate G12 security specification enforcing a permanent fail-closed hardware barrier. Automated agents, subagents, and execution scripts operate in an air-gapped zero-trust boundary with zero permissions to initiate physical PLC controller downloads, unlock hardware communication ports, or execute flashing utilities.
overview.fail_closed_rule: Physical PLC commissioning authorization defaults to FALSE under all circumstances. Automated bypass is strictly prohibited.

zero_trust_boundary.description: Zero-trust execution perimeter separating the agentic runtime from physical plant and controller hardware.

hardware_protection_invariants.title: Default Fail-Closed State
hardware_protection_invariants.description: Physical PLC commissioning authorization must evaluate to FALSE by default in CommissioningGuard instances and class state across all execution environments.

hardware_protection_invariants.title: Physical Port Unlock Barrier
hardware_protection_invariants.description: Any request or attempt to unlock COM ports, serial namespaces, CAN buses, USB devices, or JTAG interfaces without explicit authorization is intercepted and blocked.
hardware_protection_invariants.enforcement: Raises CommissioningLockedError on request_port_unlock and assert_port_safe

hardware_protection_invariants.title: Companion Flasher Execution Barrier
hardware_protection_invariants.description: Any attempt to unlock or execute companion firmware flashing utilities (PGMUpdateUtility, DfuSeCommand, STMFlashLoader, WinJTAG) without explicit authorization is intercepted and blocked.
hardware_protection_invariants.enforcement: Raises CommissioningLockedError on request_flash_tool_unlock and assert_binary_execution_safe

hardware_protection_invariants.title: Win32 Download Command Interception Barrier
hardware_protection_invariants.description: Any attempt to unlock or dispatch Win32 WM_COMMAND messages for controller download (ID 32827, ID 33149) without explicit authorization is intercepted and blocked.
hardware_protection_invariants.enforcement: Raises CommissioningLockedError on request_win32_download_unlock and assert_win32_command_safe

hardware_protection_invariants.title: Mandatory Tamper-Evident Audit Logging
hardware_protection_invariants.description: All blocked physical commissioning unlock requests and unauthorized access attempts must be recorded in an audit log with unique ID, timestamp, gate, action, target, and status.

hardware_protection_invariants.title: Physical Removable Media Exclusivity
hardware_protection_invariants.description: Actual physical controller deployment may only occur via offline physical transfer to removable media (USB drive or MicroSD card) following formal manual engineering sign-off.
hardware_protection_invariants.enforcement: Automated online downloads are permanently disabled
